exposure: distance between the spinae ischiadicae (interspinous diameter, ISD)
cohort: 240 primiparous women with breech presentation at term
finding: In primiparous women with breech presentation, a larger interspinous diameter (ISD) measured by MRI was associated with successful vaginal delivery and may be a better predictor than the commonly used conjugata vera (CV).
mod_finding: A larger interspinous diameter (ISD) measured by MRI was associated with successful vaginal delivery in primiparous women with breech presentation.
